critical_distinction: A-001..A-570 are source-local derived decomposition labels, not original 0001..2750 identifiers.
zero_loss_rules: Never merge similar names without preserving both UIDs, source references, reason, relation type and lineage.
Keep RECOVERED, DERIVED, CANONICAL, PROPOSED, IMPLEMENTED, TESTED, VERIFIED, DEPLOYED, RUNNING, HISTORICAL, CONFLICT, MISSING and UNRESOLVED distinct.
An index catalogue is not proof that all its members have been recovered.
A source mention is not proof of novelty or running behavior.
remaining_gaps: Recover original numeric registry 0001–2750 element by element.
Resolve original ID-to-name mapping for every historical entry.
Build cross-source duplicate/conflict adjudication while preserving source IDs.
Prove source/family coverage and report unresolved records.
Add durable database and trusted provider integration before financial production.
